name: gapcheck
description: GapCheck — Find the gaps before recruiters do.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,web" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "api,web" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix apps/api" "npm run start --prefix apps/web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "api,web" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
